# GUI Interface Description

## System Header Bar
- **Left Side**: "Activities" text
- **Center**: "Snap Store" text
- **Right Side**: 
  - Date and time: "Oct 22 21:22"
  - System notification bell icon

## Snap Store Window
### Window Controls
- **Top Right Corner**:
  - Minimize button (dash icon)
  - Maximize button (square icon)
  - Close button (X icon)

### Navigation Tabs
- **Left to Right**:
  - "Explore" tab with magnifying glass icon
  - "Installed" tab with checkmark icon
  - "Updates" tab with circular arrow icon and red notification dot

### Main Content Area
#### Application Display
- **Logo**: Large graphic with two overlapping circles
  - Larger circle: Dark blue with three horizontal white stripes
  - Smaller circle: Dark blue with three horizontal white stripes
  - Orange crescent shape wrapping around the left side of the larger circle
- **Text Below Logo**:
  - "Eclipse" in bold
  - "Extensible Tool Platform and Java IDE" in smaller font

#### Categories Section
- **Heading**: "Categories"
- **Category Buttons (Grid Layout)**:
  - **Row 1**:
    - "Art and Design" with image icon
    - "Books and Reference" with book icon
    - "Development" with wrench icon
  - **Row 2**:
    - "Devices and IoT" with device icon
    - "Education" with document icon
    - "Entertainment" with film strip icon
  - **Row 3**:
    - "Finance" with calculator icon
    - "Games" with game controller icon
    - "Health and Fitness" with heart icon
  - **Row 4**:
    - "Music and Audio" with musical note icon
    - "News and Weather" with sun icon
    - "Personalisation" with monitor icon

## Desktop Environment
### Left Dock
- **Application Icons (Top to Bottom)**:
  - Google Chrome
  - Thunderbird
  - Visual Studio Code
  - VLC Media Player
  - LibreOffice Writer
  - LibreOffice Calc
  - LibreOffice Impress
  - GIMP
  - Files (folder icon)
  - Ubuntu Software (orange icon with white "A", highlighted with black tooltip "Ubuntu Software")
  - Help (blue circle with white question mark)
  - Another application icon (green background with blue and white design)
  - Terminal (black background with white command prompt)
  - Trash (green recycle bin icon)
  - App Grid (3x3 grid of dots)

### Desktop Background
- Gradient from purple to red
- Geometric shapes in the background

### Desktop Icons
- **Bottom Right Corner**:
  - "Home" folder icon with house symbol
  - "Home" text label below the icon

### Secondary Window (Partially Visible)
- **Top Bar**:
  - Search icon (magnifying glass)
  - Three vertical dots menu
  - View options (three horizontal lines with dropdown arrow)
  - Minimize, maximize, close buttons
- **Content Area**:
  - Two files visible:
    - "license.key" with PGP key icon
    - "ProtectedBook.epub" with green book icon
